As far as this case is concerned, without providing an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner, the respondent has passed the impugned order, which is in violation of the principles of natural justice.

outcome.quote: The impugned order in Reference No.ZD330524067242N in GSTIN/ID No.33AFIPB0986P1Z5 dated 10.05.2024 passed by the respondent is quashed and the matter is remanded back to the respondent for fresh consideration on condition that the petitioner shall pay 10% of the disputed tax amount, within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
